paired_source_intervention_protocol: Use identical imported frozen parent `one_original_edf` code: first 2/3 chronological T1/T2 events training, last third test; C3/C4 8-12 and 13-30Hz logpower; whole-run real SOS Butterworth; flip only heldout event raw samples, train on changed vs clean, always evaluate original clean heldout samples.
primary_endpoint: per-person arithmetic mean of two within-run mean abs change in heldout predicted class-1 probability under ONLY a test-source intervention; do not treat 40 runs or individual trials as independent people
secondary_endpoints: subject-level signed accuracy change diagnostic only, no power to guarantee positive accuracy gain
per-subject train log spectral feature shift
failed validation or missing EDF explicitly retained in run logs and counted as incomplete, never silently dropped
statistical_plan: aggregate all 20 by subject; display 20 per-person paired effects, median, min/max; descriptive bootstrap over 20 subject clusters with 2000 fixed RNG seed 20261013 but do not infer clinical causality from artificial perturbation; no statistical tests over 40 runs as independent participants
stop_conditions: no silent removal of new subjects or unbalanced runs
no modifications to frozen parent model/split/feature after seeing study outputs
failure to fetch PhysioNet EDF is incomplete evidence not zero effect
exact SHA pin of parent source must still hold
not_claims: no natural signal artifact or label leakage
no dataset-specific tuning after the outcome
